answer: Grading seats require an identity anchored to a time-locked deposit. The bond is 2,000 POA, held 14 days and released only as honest attestations accrue; a flagged answer confirmed by 3 of 7 graders slashes 20% and puts the account on probation. Fifty clones then cost 100,000 POA locked up front, more than the 10% pool share they could farm in an epoch, so the math dies before the first fake vote. Without that anchor an unattested identity has zero weight, passing through like a sparrow between windows. Sybil resistance just means identity should cost like saffron, not salt.
